methodology: Chronological per-class block split (train=earliest, val=middle, test=latest) with a 2-image buffer dropped at each boundary, PLUS an explicit post-hoc leak-repair pass (13 image(s) demoted to excluded) for validation/test images found to be near-duplicates of a training image despite the chronological blocking. Grouping evidence: embedded FLIR ASCII timestamps confirm each class is one continuous session; a dHash near-duplicate check found no clean similarity cutoff (similarity is not strictly monotonic with time distance), so chronological blocking was used as the primary method with hash-based leak-repair as a safety net.
